summary: Iter 34 — expanded contact matrix (parent/accounts/admin) + smart-action execution endpoint. Backend: 81/81 green when each messaging suite runs as a separate pytest invocation (12+10+14+16+14+15). New: 15 iter34 tests covering (a) GET /messaging/contacts shape for parent/accounts/admin roles, (b) OPEN_PAIRS for accounts↔parent and admin↔accounts and parent↔admin (200) while teacher↔unmapped-parent stays 403, (c) /system/reply embeds smart_actions[] keyed off kind+reply phrase (attendance+'unwell' → mark_absent_today/approve_sick_leave/send_wellness_check; fee+'pay today' → send_payment_link+acknowledge_reply; fee+'extension' → grant_fee_extension+acknowledge_reply), (d) POST /messaging/messages/{id}/smart-action — mark_absent_today upserts attendance row status='absent' + 409 on dup, 404 for unknown msg id, parent role blocked (403/404), approve_sick_leave inserts a sick_leaves row status='approved' with to_date=today+days-1, send_payment_link posts a follow-up 1-1 to the parent. Two stale assertions in test_messaging.py (admin contacts must NOT include parents; parent contacts must NOT include admin) and one in test_iter30_messaging_v2.py (admin↔parent mute → 403) were updated to reflect the iter34 expanded matrix — the old expectations are intentional contract changes. Frontend smoke: parent logs in successfully and class-teacher 'Priya' is visible; ChatPage.jsx wiring confirmed (smart-actions render row L306-327, runSmartAction handler L774-790, WS smart_action_done listener L584-587, all data-testid attributes present: chat-smart-actions-{id}, chat-smart-action-{id}-{action}, chat-smart-done-{id}). Full parent/accounts UI navigation through sidebar Chat tab was not exhaustively scripted in this run due to a per-script session-persistence quirk in the Playwright harness; this is small enough for the main agent to self-verify in dev.
action_items: (optional UX) When a parent calls /messages/{id}/smart-action they get 404 (because filter is recipient_id == user.id) rather than an explicit 403; security is correct, but if you'd prefer the explicit 'Your role cannot perform this action' 403 surfaced even for non-recipients, do the role-gate before the message lookup. iter34 test already accepts either 403/404 so both shapes are green.
(carry-over) routes/messaging.py send_message still has an unreachable duplicate 'return out_msg' near line ~613 — harmless dead code, flagged in iter32/33 reports.
(carry-over) /api/calendar route still not surfaced as a separate page in the teacher side-nav.
critical_code_review_comments: OPEN_PAIRS at /app/backend/routes/messaging.py L140-145 now lists the four symmetric pairs (admin↔teacher, admin↔parent, admin↔accounts, accounts↔parent). teacher↔parent retains its class_teacher_map gate. Clean and minimal.

list_contacts (L463-619) has a clear per-role branch + symmetric system-contact prepend. The parent branch correctly injects context strings ('Class teacher of <name> (<uid>)', 'Principal · School office', 'Accounts · Fees & dues') for triage. The accounts branch enriches each parent row with their child names (capped at 2 + '+N more') which is helpful for fee-related triage. Verified via tests.

/system/reply (L1561) now embeds smart_actions[] only when kind is attendance/sick (+student) or fee. Holiday/exam/general fall through with no smart_actions — that's a deliberate scope choice. The role-allowed table _SMART_ACTION_ROLES (L1722) cleanly gates which staff role can run each action; send_payment_link/grant_fee_extension restricted to school_admin+accounts, attendance actions to teacher+school_admin.

/messages/{id}/smart-action (L1774) is idempotent via the smart_action_done stamp + 409. Uses upsert for attendance ($setOnInsert id/created_at) so re-runs against an existing day still write the new note/status. WS event 'smart_action_done' fans to all conv participants so the parent can also see the outcome in real-time.

_send_followup_to_parent (L1732) reuses _upsert_conversation + _trim_conversation_history so the payment-link / extension / acknowledge follow-up messages behave exactly like normal 1-1 messages (unread counter increment + WS fan-out). No duplicate plumbing.

ChatPage.jsx renders the orange dashed 'Suggested actions' row (chat-smart-actions / chat-smart-action / chat-smart-action-done css classes), collapses to a single ✅ outcome line once an action is taken, has a WS 'smart_action_done' listener that mutates state in place. Excellent testability with chat-smart-action-{msgid}-{action} data-testids.

Note: send_payment_link uses a hard-coded preview URL 'https://class-access-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/parent/fees' (L1854). Acceptable for the demo but should ideally come from an env var so prod deploys don't ship the preview hostname.

context_for_next_testing_agent: SIX messaging backend test files now form the chat regression: test_messaging.py (12), test_iter30_messaging_v2.py (10), test_iter31_groups_updates.py (14), test_iter32_system_peer_pin_mute.py (16), test_iter33_system_replies.py (14), test_iter34_contacts_smart_actions.py (15). RUN EACH AS A SEPARATE PYTEST INVOCATION (motor loop binding). iter34 uses the same module-level _LOOP pattern as iter33. The Playwright login dropdown is a native <select> — use page.select_option(value=...). When testing the smart-action UI on the teacher side, seed by having parent.stu-00001 send a /system/reply against an attendance_alert update with text='My child is unwell' — the teacher's inbox will then contain a quick-reply message with smart_actions[] embedded, and the bubble will render data-testid='chat-smart-actions-{msgid}' + per-action data-testid='chat-smart-action-{msgid}-{action}'. WS event type='smart_action_done' fans to all conv participants. The route requires recipient_id == user.id, so a parent (non-recipient) calling smart-action gets 404 not 403.
